items.q: Is modern society a complete meritocracy?
items.correct: No — structural inequalities of class, gender and ethnicity affect life chances.
items.misconception: Yes, anyone can succeed regardless of background.
items.why: Sociologists highlight barriers that mean success isn't purely down to effort.

items.q: Does social class still affect people's lives?
items.correct: Yes — it influences health, education and opportunities.
items.random_wrong: Everyone now has identical life chances.
items.why: Class remains linked to major differences in outcomes and opportunities.
